Government extends export incentive scheme by a year

By Staff Writer, New Delhi
The government on Monday extended the export incentive scheme for another year, giving exporters of engineering goods and textiles more time to claim refunds of embedded duties.
The scheme refunds central, state and local levies that are not otherwise rebated, such as electricity duty and fuel taxes used in transport, the commerce ministry said.
Advertisement
Exporters in special economic zones and export-oriented units will also be covered, a long-standing demand of the industry, officials said, adding that rates will be notified soon.
Industry bodies welcomed the move, saying it would help firms facing weak demand in Europe and higher freight costs since shipping routes were disrupted earlier this year.
